summary: Accessing arguments.callee in a strict/unmapped arguments object throws TypeError.

target.template: JsRuntime.ThrowTypeError("'callee' is not accessible on strict arguments")
target.notes: Preserve the throwing accessor instead of exposing the current C# delegate.

caveats: Non-strict mapped arguments has legacy callee semantics and is handled separately/runtime.

tests.name: strict callee throws
tests.input: function f(){'use strict'; return arguments.callee;} try{f()}catch(e){console.log(e instanceof TypeError)}
